description: Données ouvertes Transport Ferroviaire - Ateliers d'entretien des trains du Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Transports. Ces données contient des informations sur la localisation administrative (région, préfecture, commune, canton), les établissements (nom, ID, bâtiment associé), les problèmes identifiés et remarques, ainsi que les dates de collecte et de mise à jour. Il inclut également des coordonnées géographiques pour la localisation précise des pistes ferroviaire. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Transports. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-05-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
